payload.reason: The research in machine translation was not adopted in the 1960s due to a lack of federal funding, limited access to computers, and the theoretical nature of the work without practical implementation.

claims.text: The Croatian research group lacked federal funding, which prevented the creation of a prototype machine translation system.
Unlike their counterparts in the USA and USSR, the Croatian group had no access to actual computers, limiting their research to theoretical work.
The results of machine translation research in the late 1950s were poor, leading to a lack of practical systems being demonstrated.
